notes.title: Railroad Corporation - Balance Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We're happy to see that you're excited for Railroad Corporation 2, but today is all about the original! This update is mostly focused on balance, making the early missions a little more lenient for new players.

Made multiple balance improvements to the Road to Success campaign. 

Changed bonuses of companies in Chapter One:

 Picket Railroads now gives extra money at the beginning of each mission: $40,000 instead of $10,000. 
 Cain Eastern Railway now gives multiple bonuses. John Bull locomotives are present invented from the very beginning and one of them is given at the start of each mission instead of one Best Friend locomotive. This company also provides a 30% discount for Best Friend locomotives.
 Harrington's Railroad now further reduces rail laying costs: 15% instead of 10%, also soil excavation costs 35% less.

We've improved starting conditions for the chapter one missions and reduced the severity of overdraft in all the ‘Road to Success’ campaign missions for better adaptation of new players. Adjusted free game settings for these missions to reflect the changes.

Mission 1 “Hot steel for Cincinnati”:

 increased starting money from $100,000 to $200,000;
 disabled overdraft and overdraft gameover condition;
 added a new objective to familiarize the player with locomotive repair mechanics.

Missions 2 “Real deals”:

 increased starting money from $100,000 to $200,000;
 disabled overdraft and overdraft gameover condition.

Mission 3 “Monopoly”:

 increased starting money from $300,000 to $400,000;
 disabled overdraft and overdraft gameover condition.

Missions 4 “The Carolinas”:

 increased starting money from $100,000 to $200,000;
 disabled overdraft and overdraft gameover condition.

Missions 5-12:

 changed maximum overdraft amount from $50,000 to $200,000.
 changed overdraft rate from 1% to 0,5%;

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33938069/e346ed019c4e0a668400e5a9f035848b1b93e4fb.jpg

Wildlands multiplayer map: 

  $300,000 starting money as a default option
  a new option of $400,000 starting money in addition to the existing ones.


Miscellaneous changes & fixes:

 Fixed a minor bug with wrongly reported reasons to the events log if a train is unable to load commodities due to low company money balance.
 Increased research speed multiplier to 3 in following multiplayer maps: Volatile Markets, Shipyard, City Prosperity, The Great Partnership, Weapon baron, Battle of Fredericksburg, Blame your destiny, True competition, Wild lands, Government Tender Competition.


That's it for today—give these changes a try and let us know what you think!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33938069/9119f9723f0fc27715ad69be3a3dbd2c57eb6f99.png

notes.title: UPDATE: co-op mode and THREE NEW maps!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

The holidays are coming up, and so here is our gift to you.

Co-op is here!
We've been cooking this up for a while now. Co-op is a separate multiplayer mode that puts you and your friend in challenging scenarios where you have no choice but to work together. Support each other in contract work, use each others' railroads, and unite to survive. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33938069/393c0d06708e6e2cbaede7eabc1c2c79fcf30662.png

Features:

 Work together on the same goals and tasks
 Help each other out! When one player loses, the game is over
 Contracts can be fulfilled by any player but reward will be received by the one who signed it
 No fee charges when using other player’s railroads
 Game can be paused during cooperative sessions
 Communication during the session is possible via in-game chat
 Special co-op scenarios achievements!



Special co-op maps
Of course, a new mode is best enjoyed in tailor-made maps. When you boot up co-op mode, you can choose between 3 brand new maps to play with your business partner.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33938069/6f3af185380379bd2e4434c28d88f62901580a41.png


Shipyard
The city of Westerly has recently constructed a shipyard. Of course, a shipyard needs ships, and ships need wood. That's what you and your business partner are going to provide!

City prosperity
Local authorities have issued licenses for rail transport! The condition, however, is that carriers improve development and prosperity in the region. You'll achieve this by providing railroad networks from town to town. 

The Great Partnership
And of course, there's a sandbox map with no set objectives! You and your partner can explore this large map to your heart's content. 

Other changes
Not into co-op? That's okay! We have some other changes as well, like auto-trading rules that allow you to set up what commodities to buy, sell or move between your factories automatically. Check out the changes here.

Invite a friend and give the new mode a whirl. And of course, let us know what you think on Discord!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33938069/9119f9723f0fc27715ad69be3a3dbd2c57eb6f99.png

notes.title: Signals & Workshop Update Out Now!
notes.notes:
We're very excited to share the Signals & Workshop update with you today! In short, signalling directions for track segments and Steam Workshop integration have been added to the game. So, here's what's what, including a big ol' changelog like you're used to from us.

Signal track directions!
In every mode and mission, it is now possible to change the directions trains can go in, per segment of track. Just click the track icon with the traffic lights in the top right of the screen when playing any mission, map or scenario. Then, click on any segment of the track to change the allowed direction of trains on that section. Single, green arrows signal a one-way track, and blue double arrows signal a two-way track.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33938069/d7cc33e0bd7a727fd028d055da3475d43c72ee3c.gif

Create and share via the Editor and Steam Workshop integration
Railroad Corporation now has Steam Workshop integration! You can create and share new maps, scenarios and missions for both singleplayer and multiplayer from the editor in the main menu, and you can play community maps, scenarios and missions by subscribing to them from the Steam Workshop hub! Note that the editor has a 'beta' tag on it. That's because the editor might still contain some bugs. If you find any, please let us know in the bug reports section of the Steam forum.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33938069/06af807118f9a1fd77bc35557b7f5bf6e925c4d2.png

That's not all, check out the full changelog below!

New features
Railroad directions and signals
To optimize traffic, players are now able to set railroad directions for each segment. Railroad signal poles now reflect the railroad direction setting and prohibit or allow locomotive’s movement. Hold Alt-key to quickly edit directions.

Editor, beta release
Use Steam Workshop functionality to create, share and play singleplayer and multiplayer maps, missions and scenarios made by the community and yourself.

Train locomotive replacement
Now a locomotive replacement into a new one can be scheduled in the next train’s waypoint. 

Different resource consumption rates for each city
Cities can now have different consumption speed, so players may plan which commodity is in higher or lower demand in a certain city.

City population growth rate
Population growth is affected by fulfilling resource demands in the city hall or local industries. The amount of population growth may differ for individual resources.

UI Top Panel notifications
Quantity of completed research items is now highlighted with a notification mark in the top panel. A similar notification is shown for new contracts, new staffing availability and new laws.

Commodity selling to a city from your own factories
It's now possible to prohibit your own production facilities from selling commodities to City Halls.

Using opponents' railroads for pathfinding
It's now possible to prohibit your locomotives from using the opponent’s railroad while pathfinding.

Improvements
 Per locomotive lifetime accounting has been added to the train list.
 Road length is limited to avoid ineffective cross-map one-click railroad construction.
 Couple autosave files have been added to avoid saving right before overdraft or other lose conditions.
 Locomotive price of unresearched locomotives is now visible in the characteristics tooltip of the research.
 Pathfinding algorithm for locomotives has been optimized.
 Overall performance optimization.

Fixes
 Newly applied routes now stays visible while repairing and refuelling at the station.
 Auction panel may duplicate player portraits in some cases. 
 Repair action does not reset load/unload actions for the locomotive now. 
 Technologies production launch could be delayed for in some cases.

notes.title: PATCH 0.1.7960 OUT NOW - NEW FEATURES AND FIXES
notes.notes:
PATCH UPDATE

This patch focuses mostly on solving the duplicating labels issue and on some optimization for single-player mode. Along with the fixes, this patch adds some new features.

New features:
 Building demolishing. It is now possible to demolish own buildings and construct another one on the land spot instead.
 Warehouses can be upgraded now to increase storage capacity.
 Added commodities trading directly from your own industry property. Now it is not necessary to do commodity transfers via warehouses to sell it to a city.
 Research time and money requirements changed (balance improvement).
 Mail weight is increased (balance improvement).
 Influence of laws is increased (balance improvement).
 Building buying and construction prices are increased (balance improvement).

Fixes:
 Fix of missed or duplicated train labels.
 Multiplayer 'Blame your Destiny' Mission 5M goal fix
 Fix of background train activity, when UI was not reflecting actual train actions in time.
 Fix of possible error with train movement lags. 
 Fix of misleading train breakage messages.
 General minor FPS, game performance optimization.
 Overdraft notification checkbox error
 Instant demand/supply in buildings error
 Scrap carriages misleading UI error
 Buildings layout improvement 

The game roadmap is published here, feel free to have a look!

notes.title: Railroad Corporation - Multiplayer Update
notes.notes:
Dearest Business Owners,

It is our outermost pleasure to announce that Railroad Corporation shall be receiving a new Multiplayer Update on this very day. Aforementioned update is exciting because it includes additional multiplayer maps that all hast various sizes and preconditions. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33938069/488de678c3ab22d9ea099684085d5292ea011215.png

For instance, one of the maps shall be mirrored – meaning each team can compete against one another with identical opportunities and challenges. Another map shall hast randomized settings so that the playable towns and the produce available shall be shuffled upon start, meaning that thou won’t necessarily hast the like opportunities and challenges as thy opponents. 

Summon thy friends and issue, fellow content creators or whyfore not thy arch-enemy in the quest towards having the most marvelous establishment of the century. 

- Fare thee well from the 19th Century Railroad Corporation squad.

Pssst! To celebrate this update, we are giving away free Steam keys in our Discord. Join here to see how you can enter.


Changelog

NEW MULTIPLAYER MAPS
Get ready, because in this update we have added three new multiplayer scenarios, each of which has certain unique features. Face of against your opponent in the True Competition, race to complete a weapons delivery contract in Weapon Baron and pray that the dice roll in your favor in Blame Your Destiny!

TRUE COMPETITION
The map in this scenario is mirrored, as well as your office location and cities with resources. Contracts don’t spawn either, to make sure no random events influence the balance of your match. The session can be launched with extra competitive goals to complete, however. The host can set those when setting up a match.

WEAPON BARON
Who can produce and transport weapons the fastest?! Face of against your opponent in a race to deliver weapons to a nearby town. The map you\ll be playing on will provide different options to complete your goal, depending on your starting location.

BLAME YOUR DESTINY
This is our first randomized multiplayer map! Your office location as well as other cities and resources are completely random each time the multiplayer session is created. Who knows what your next match will be like!

Each of the new scenarios contains sets of editable launch conditions that can be adjusted by the game host. You can edit the difficulty by changing the overdraft-ruleset, add extra objectives and much more!

Extras:

Fixed a bug, when one player leaves multiplayer map while it’s loading, the game could start inadvertently with only one player. This could cause a crash to occur.
Localization has been updated.

notes.title: Railroad Corporation Sandbox Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We are really happy to finally be releasing one of the biggest updates to Railroad Corporation: the sandbox mode! This new update will allow you to fully focus on expanding your train network and growing your corporation, without limitations, timers or objectives. It also means that the game will be more customisable since it lets you experiment and practice in a brand-new gameplay mode.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33938069/9e6ac86de3ebe5597dcd9d8fac118fdf1954f238.png

There are two new sandbox maps with randomisation of city locations and production facilities, and an option to have all locomotives pre-researched from the very beginning. There are also various options for amount of initial capital and overdraft, which lets you set the level of difficulty that you wish to play.

Want to have a first look at the sandbox update? Check out the video below where Iceberg Interactive's Kevin & Shona explore this newly added game mode.

https://youtu.be/ZZJiF3v3dFs
Patch notes: July 18th

Introducing two new sandbox maps with the following adjustable settings

Randomisation of cities location and production facilities
Random seed can be copied for future reuse
Overdraft limits customisation
Amount of initial capital customisation
All locomotives can be researched from the very beginning


Settings that can be enabled/disabled

Contracts spawning
Staff hiring
Finance department for bonds and loans
Real estate purchase
Warehouse global goods market
City laws spawning


Updates to campaign missions

Successfully completed campaign missions can be launched in a free play mode with the default time limits, without limits in a limitless mode or with all objectives disabled 
Campaign research and character skills progress will be ignored
Overdraft and initial capital settings can be adjusted for campaign missions in a free mode


Introducing “Government tender competition - Long Play mode”

Added second scenario for already existing multiplayer map
Initial capital increased to $200,000
Target company value increased to 2 million
Already completed research added: John Bull locomotive


Balance adjustments to multiplayer maps

Whisky Refinery has been relocated from Irving to Frisco

Atlanta now consumes Whiskey from the very beginning

Improvements

Campaign can be started with no deadlines now. Added a special campaign launch option
City growth algorithm along the river is improved
Added players custom notes for locomotives in the left side locomotive list
Added city route point button next to a city title to be able to add multiple similar stations to train’s route
Added camera focus on object when double-clicking on the train list or building list
Added camera focus icon to the selected object dialog

We hope you enjoy the sandbox update. Keep your feedback coming & stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: Update 01: Balance & Time Limits
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

One of the most common concerns we received since the release from players is a time limit set in campaign missions. In this quick patch, No.01, we are tweaking these limits so players are not pushed too hard to finish the mission fast, but for those who manage to complete tasks fast enough; there's an experience bonus you can earn.

To see these changes, let the game automatically update through Steam and start a new campaign from the main menu. If you're in the middle of a mission now, the next mission will also reflect these changes.

Of course, there are other critical issues we see and we are working on them already, too. Still, we decided to release this fix to not delay its delivery of what we think will improve gameplay experience right away.

We appreciate all feedback, especially during this Early Access period, and we will take all of your comments and suggestions in consideration to further improve the game.  

We have exciting plans for Railroad Corporation in Early Access and we'll have a roadmap to share, soon!

Thank you for your support!

Love,
The Corbie Games team
